name: 白鶴
illustrationTaxon: Leucogeranus leucogeranus adult; monotypic per source. Juvenile is extensively ginger on head/neck/upperparts and not shown here.

similarSpecies.distinction: 體羽灰色而非全白；頭頸黑色、頸側有白紋，頭頂紅斑小；嘴偏黃。本種成鳥全身白、臉部大片紅色裸皮。
同為白色身體，但頸及三級飛羽黑色、形成明顯黑色尾塊，頭頂紅斑只限頭頂；本種無黑色尾塊，紅色在臉頰裸皮。

featureNotes: 眼周至嘴基的大片紅色裸皮，白色頭頸形成對比（第1圈實際可見）。
細長嘴呈淡粉角質色、帶深色縱紋，嘴基接紅色裸皮；不是灰鶴的黃嘴（第2圈實際可見）。
全身白羽及折疊的白翼，看不到任何黑色翼尖（第3圈實際可見；折翼狀態，飛行時初級飛羽為黑色，本圈不代表飛行翼色）。
粉紅色長腿及長趾（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

rangeMap.caption: 世界底圖・部分分佈國家
rangeMap.disclaimer: 綠色非全境；非完整分佈
rangeMap.note: Country overview only: the only viable breeding population is in east-central Siberia and the only regular wintering area is along the middle Yangtze in China, mainly Poyang Lake; the species has also been recorded in Japan and Taiwan, and India is retained only as a former/historical wintering country. Seasons are not separated on the card.

sources.use: HKBWS substantive identification/range/conservation read: 140cm, adult at rest all-white apart from reddish face, bill base and legs; juveniles extensively ginger on head, neck, upperparts and primary coverts; in flight black primaries and upperwing lesser coverts; monotypic; only viable breeding population in east-central Siberia, regular wintering middle Yangtze (mainly Poyang Lake), also Japan and Taiwan; IUCN CRITICALLY ENDANGERED, decreasing.
Runtime Chinese name 白鶴 unchanged.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對羽色、嘴、臉部裸皮及腳顏色；不是照片，也不是分佈或族群證據。
比較鳥為 AI 生成示意，非等比例，也不是完整鶴科鑑別檢索表。
